parsed.name: PICA 启动器应用
parsed.description: 用于实验软件资源访问与脚本启动的非实体桌面应用。它提供图形界面来创建启动器与资源面板、打开说明文档和仓库链接、定位脚本目录、启动相关脚本、输出日志，并可运行 GPIB 测试工具，适合在实验环境中集中入口管理各类实用程序。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical desktop application for accessing experiment-related resources and launching scripts. It provides a GUI to build launcher and resource panels, open documentation and repository links, locate script folders, run related scripts, display logs, and start a GPIB test utility, serving as a central entry point for lab utilities.

actions.description: 创建启动器面板，用于在界面中组织和显示可启动的实验脚本与工具入口。
actions.description_en: Create the launcher panel to organize and display launchable experiment scripts and utility entry points in the GUI.

actions.description: 创建资源面板，用于显示文档、版本、许可证和仓库等资源入口。
actions.description_en: Create the resource panel to present links to documentation, version information, license, and repository resources.

actions.description: 创建应用界面组件，初始化启动器与资源相关的图形控件。
actions.description_en: Create the application widgets and initialize GUI components related to the launcher and resources.

actions.description: 启动指定脚本，作为实验相关实用程序或子应用的入口。
actions.description_en: Launch a specified script as an entry point to an experiment-related utility or sub-application.

actions.description: 记录日志消息，并在界面控制台中附带时间戳显示。
actions.description_en: Log a message and display it with a timestamp in the application's console widget.

actions.description: 打开许可证信息，便于查看软件授权内容。
actions.description_en: Open the license information so the software licensing terms can be viewed.

actions.description: 打开手册文件，便于查看软件使用说明。
actions.description_en: Open the manual file so the software usage instructions can be viewed.

actions.description: 打开 README 文档，便于查看项目简介与使用说明。
actions.description_en: Open the README document to view the project overview and usage notes.

actions.description: 打开项目仓库链接，便于访问源代码或在线资源页面。
actions.description_en: Open the project repository link to access source code or related online resources.

actions.description: 打开指定脚本所在文件夹，便于查看、管理或手动运行相关文件。
actions.description_en: Open the folder containing a specified script for inspection, management, or manual execution.

actions.description: 打开更新信息入口，便于查看软件版本更新内容。
actions.description_en: Open the updates entry to view software version changes and update information.

actions.description: 运行 GPIB 测试工具，用于检查实验通信环境中的 GPIB 相关功能。
actions.description_en: Run the GPIB test utility to check GPIB-related functionality in the lab communication environment.

actions.description: 设置界面样式，定义应用图形界面的显示风格。
actions.description_en: Set up the GUI styles to define the application's visual appearance.
